notes.title: 0.7.15 Update - New Semi Tractor, Car Carrier Trailer, Ambulance
notes.content:
0.7.15 Build 904 Hotfix

Bug Fixed

\[Dedi] Police white-list UI not deactivated when feature is disabled (Thanks to Cody)

\[UI] Out of battery help message spam while autopilot (Thanks to Owlen)

\[Vehicle] Semi Tractor not driving straight with trailer (Thanks to Toll99)



Demo Bug Fixed

Due to an error in the previous 0.7.15 release, the Level 2 cap was unintentionally removed in the Demo.

If you played the demo and leveled up beyond Level 2, please create a new character and email us at p3games.motortown@gmail.com with the following details:

- Your old character name and level

- Your new character name

We will send in-game money to your new character based on your previous progress.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.


[hr][/hr]

notes.title: 0.7.14 Update - Company Depot, Mine Truck, B-Double Grain Hopper Trailer
notes.content:
-- BUILD 871 HOTFIX (2025/08/08) --

Bug Fixed: Cannot change company name (Thanks to Buffalo)

Bug Fixed: Server name text broken

Bug Fixed: Winch stuck under the vehicle after install from modded tune at the workshop (You can uninstall the bad winch by using the workshop again) (Thanks to Nikk and Paulo Roberto)

In-game menu leaderboard optimized

-- BUILD 865 HOTFIX (2025/06/30) --

Bug Fixed: Force Feedback not working with G920/923 (Thanks to Tudesky)



Hello, fellow drivers! We have another update! 

Thanks to everyone who helped with the test!  



Before we look into the update,
If you are using MOD and your game crashes, please try uninstalling MOD
And probably better try uninstalling MOD if you find some strange bug, too!


Bob The Mad Man made this cool update overview![previewyoutube="L-3WaQmOsoY;full"][/previewyoutube]

Unreal Engine version is updated from 5.3 to 5.5
Some engine bugs have been fixed, and we've also encountered some new ones!

And we Devs got new toys in our hands to make more interesting stuff in the future update!


Company Depot
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/5d13754062fb4de9ed417a0f20d9094dc29bc510.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/533f1c04d753b6e93e26ff49be280c1a1ccf4ce5.png"]

Depot is here to refresh your company's AI vehicles automatically.



Two depot blueprints are available at the architect's office.

The depot list is added to the company UI

The depot is deactivated if it's still under construction.

The active depot consumes running costs from the company.



You can add a depot to a bus/truck route

Company AI restores vehicle conditions when they visit the depot, using the depot's storage

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/3e1b267d6f0448bdea8e17d14b47172a5c484a5c.png"]



You need to restock the depot's storage, using UI, or deliver cargo

Restock delivery spawns when storage is under 50%. 

You can see the delivery by selecting the depot at the company UI

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/d196354f2254dc6275b0872e6b4563c53e59cecf.png"]

You can still use the good old refresh vehicle condition button on each vehicle


Company vehicle slot limit is increased from 10 to 15
With the cost increasing at each step


Low-condition company vehicle and a low-storage depot alarm are added to the HUD
You can now check the company vehicles' conditions without opening the company UI

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/06da7f8751e7f3d005f2e03181746825735bf105.png"]


Windows Task Bar blinking
Now the Windows taskbar icon blinks when

Autopilot arrived destination

The company vehicle's condition is low


Hobber, new grain hopper B-double trailers
You can buy these at the Trailer dealership

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/bbfd13cbccbb695d4773a69a1b99e36b4162cb13.png"]


Sunflower farm and Sunflower Seed delivery
Oji Sunflower Farm is now producing sunflower seeds

You can use Dump, Dry Bulk, and a  new Grain truck to deliver this

You can only export these to harbors at the moment, more production lines will be added in future updates.


Terra
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/9ecdaad97a812619cf3e874e689aa4c6d50eea05.png"]

A new mine truck is added at the Dongsan Limestone Quarry

It has a large cargo space

It has a durable brake pad and reduced body damage

It has better traction on deep surfaces like sand and mud

It has high condition usage on paved roads and low condition usage on off-road by the company AI

You can see the nearby quarry's production status on the map

Navigation will automatically set to the nearby quarry with the  largest stockpile



Terra Factory

You need to supply Terra Factory at the South of Oji island to buy or deliver them

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/0c308eb59a275e026e5cedf28d4e05cc9b66acc6.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/e52ae5382a7f40e80b3d55995480f286c006ec98.png"]


Limestone Rock processing
The limestone quarry's rock crusher is now operational. 

You need to deliver limestone rock from each quarry to the rock crusher to produce limestone.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/11e4c4d3d043f6f8f5c228084075bcae1cc9bad4.png"]
Drop Off (Thanks to Skirakzalus)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/c40ece6fa761203104cbd6fba594d998ead9bb91.png"]

The cargo drop-off location is now interactive

You can open the production site after interacting with the drop-off location

You can see which drop-off location goes to which production site in the world map

Interaction key lower dump bed if it's raised while overlapping with the drop-off location


Police Patrol minor renewal
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/ec904103e8729859d8440dce079472ff94951270.png"]

Patrol points are now grouped by each patrol area (Circle on the map)

The town patrol rate is increased once completing all the patrol points in the area

You can receive payment for both the patrol point and for completing the area

Multiple players can complete the area together and split the completion payment


Kuda Flatbed
Available at the Truck Dealership

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/c228a950376f5b437dcea7cb248fe3e6f2ae645a.png"]


Quicklime Production
Dongsan Cement factory now produces quicklime.

Quicklime boosts farm production.


Vehicle Tags
You can now set 3 custom tags to your own vehicles and filter by tags in the spawn list

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/06e65dcaee04ce3501d46e7e54f05db8d4cd1cda.png"]


Visible Decaled-Vehicle count is now bound with the Graphic/Texture option
You can see more vehicles with decals with a higher texture option


The roadside towing service cost increased
The roadside towing service cost increased based on

Distance

Terrain

Weight (including cargo)


Surrender (Thanks to Musti)
You can now surrender while in suspect state, by 'R' key or open the control panel -> Roadside service


Force Feedback lost with Simagic (Thanks to Stinger)
The force feedback-related library is updated. 


MOD warnings
A warning message shows up if you installed MOD or when trying to join a server with MOD

Note that you can be excluded from the leaderboard and might not get the achievement if you use MOD

Minds that Steel Coil is quite heavy. So putting it on the right spot is important for the truck's weight distribution

Hello, fellow drivers!

Tire Improvement
Tire simulation had a problem when the vertical load was high, which made tires lose stiffness in cornering(like low air pressure), especially with heavy loads or heavy vehicles.
It's now fixed and most vehicles will feel a little bit more sharp, large trucks will roll over instead of slide.

If your small vehicle feels too snappy and unforgiving in this version, use KM1-65 tire(high profile) and avoid KM2-45 tire(low profile soft compound)
Using KM2-45 on the rear wheel could help keep in straight, but spin recovery will be more difficult.

Top-speed increased
Vehicles had unintended drag that affects top speed, now top speed is a little bit increased.

Supermarket and Warehouse
Supermarkets are now receiving food cargo
You can deliver foods from the farm and factories to the supermarket directly, or stock them up at any warehouses to optimize logistics.
Mind that those supermarket drop points are usually in the narrow space, so small vehicles are recommended.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/8bbaca38d91935c4eec7bb9bca42cc5eb8d5ae1c.png


Town Effects
Now town effect is divided by each town
Each town has a terminal and a supermarket
Each town has its own bus/food/patrol/garbage coverage
More coverage increases the zone's population bonus
Population bonus increase zone's job payment

You can see town border at the world map (Check Town filter at the right bottom)

Current bonus formula is (Will be changed from time to time for better balance)
Town Population Bonus = Bus Coverage + Food Supply + (Patrol Coverage * 0.2) + (Garbage Collection * 0.2)
Town Payment Bonus = Town Population Bonus * 0.2 (Max 30%)

Gapa is currently covering all Oji areas and more towns will be added later.

notes.content:
Hello, fellow drivers!
The company was the most wanted feature in our in-game feature request.
In this update, you can now invite other players or join other player's company.
And you can create a Corporation in a Dedicated server that has its own Vehicle list and Budget, which allows it to keep running while owner is offline.

If you want to create a company, visit the Cityhall, near Gang-Jung.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/19da36bd86fe9795f57f7dbdd3fd0e43647255f4.png

Company
Now you can invite other players to your company (from the player list in the in-game menu)
Or you can request to join another player's company (from the company list in the in-game menu)
If you already have a company and join another company, your own company will be deactivated in that session
Company is only available while the owner is online.

Corporation
Corporation is another type of Company, that only available in a Dedicated Server
You can create a 'Corporation' with $100,000 seed money
Corporation has its own Vehicles and Money balance
Corporation Owner can hand over their own vehicle to the Corporation, or take it back (By the Add/Remove Company Vehicle menu)
Corporation don't require owners to be online.

Company members can be assigned to 'Manager' role (More roles and permission will be added later)
Managers can accept join requests or invite other players
Manager can kick members or assign manager role

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/8d457b61c83b188bf840e7dc605e4d0176eb68c7.png

Contract

Only a Company owner or manager can sign a contract
'Online Access' contract allows company members to see the production & delivery lists from map
'Supply' contract gives a bonus for each delivery and a completion bonus once required deliveries are finished
'Fast Travel' contract allows company members to teleport to a delivery point from the map

notes.content:
Hello, fellow drivers! We have another update!
Thanks to everyone who helped with the test!

Bus Company
You can now create a company and let AI Bus drivers work for you!

[How to create Bus Company]
Visit NPC at the City hall(East South side of Seo-Gui-Po Downtown)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/a256a12afc92fc317548d87cefb58228c63dade7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/5d0e1ac48c463d01e1902f5f91ba2efea3943013.png

[Company Tutorial]
1. Summon your own bus and park it near the road
2. Press 'O' or 'LB + Gamepad Special Left' to open Company UI
3. Add Bus
4. Assign Bus to a Route
5. AI Driver starts to drive (Player must not drive it)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40326040/c118fc92fb47bd66624fecd4fa5fd61e9250b3fb.png

[How to remove AI Driver]
Un-assign route or remove the vehicle from the company
You can summon a vehicle or drive it to override the AI driver

[Running Cost]
Company Vehicle cost money while they are running
You can un-assign the route to stop it

[Condition]
Company Vehicle's condition will be consumed while running, especially with more passengers.
The bus cannot accept more passengers with 0 Conditions, and you need to click the 'Maintenance' button to restore the condition.

[Stuck]
AI driver will be stuck, and this will be visible on the Company Vehicle List as 'Stuck'
You can call roadside service at the Company UI.
Sometimes you need to go there and drive it a little bit to resolve issues.

[Bus Route]
The system route is added as the default when you create the company.
You can edit these and add more.
You can talk to passengers at the bus stop to know where they are going. Use it to make an optimal route!
You can import/export bus routes using the clipboard. Share your route with your friends!
You can use the company route when you drive a bus. 
(Other players cannot use your company route, yet)

[Bus Passenger]
Now we have 200 residents on the island.
They all have homes and workplaces (or schools).
They need to commute and visit commercial areas from time to time.
They spawn at the nearest bus stop and hop in the bus which goes nearest bus stop of destination or nearest Bus Terminal(Gang-Jung/Jeju/Seong-San/Hallim)
This means they pile up at the Terminal
So, the basic strategy would be having 2 kinds of bus routes, one for Terminal-To-Local-Area, and one for Terminal-To-Terminal
There is a 'Bus Usage' at the Town Effect(in-game menu), meaning how many residents used the bus successfully. 
The resident population and bus payments are increased based on Bus usage.
